roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.absorb_slice
roots.source_signature:
theorem absorb_slice {l m r : ℕ} (A : Core l m)
    (R : _root_.Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ) (bit : Fin 2) :
    slice (absorb A R) bit = slice A bit * R

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.exists_core_lq
roots.source_signature:
theorem exists_core_lq {l r : ℕ} (A : Core l r) :
    ∃ (R : _root_.Matrix (Fin l) (Fin (min l (2 * r))) ℝ)
      (Q : Core (min l (2 * r)) r), A = R * Q ∧ Q * Q.transpose = 1

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.exists_rightCanonical
roots.source_signature:
theorem exists_rightCanonical {n l r : ℕ} (C : Chain n l r) :
    ∃ (l' : ℕ) (R : _root_.Matrix (Fin l) (Fin l') ℝ) (D : Chain n l' r),
      RightCanonical D ∧ RankReduced C D ∧ ∀ x, contract C x = R * contract D x

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.RankReduced.head_bound
roots.source_signature:
theorem RankReduced.head_bound {n l l' r : ℕ} {C : Chain (n + 1) l r}
    {D : Chain (n + 1) l' r} (h : RankReduced C D) :
    l' ≤ l ∧ ∃ m', ∃ (Q : Core l' m') (tail : Chain n m' r),
      D = .cons Q tail ∧ l' ≤ 2 * m'

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.RankReduced.last_bond_le_two
roots.source_signature:
theorem RankReduced.last_bond_le_two {l l' : ℕ} {C : Chain 1 l 1}
    {D : Chain 1 l' 1} (h : RankReduced C D) : l' ≤ 2

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.mass
roots.source_signature: noncomputable def mass {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (v : I → ℝ) : ℝ

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.mass_vecMul
roots.source_signature:
theorem mass_vecMul {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I]
    (A : _root_.Matrix I J ℝ) (hA : A * A.transpose = 1) (v : I → ℝ) :
    mass (_root_.Matrix.vecMul v A) = mass v

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.chainMass
roots.source_signature: noncomputable def chainMass {n l r : ℕ} (C : Chain n l r) (v : Fin l → ℝ) : ℝ

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.chainMass_eq
roots.source_signature:
theorem chainMass_eq {n l r : ℕ} (C : Chain n l r) (hC : RightCanonical C)
    (v : Fin l → ℝ) : chainMass C v = mass v

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.residual_mass
roots.source_signature:
theorem residual_mass {n l l' r : ℕ} (C : Chain n l r) (D : Chain n l' r)
    (R : _root_.Matrix (Fin l) (Fin l') ℝ) (hD : RightCanonical D)
    (h : ∀ x, contract C x = R * contract D x) (v : Fin l → ℝ) :
    chainMass C v = mass (_root_.Matrix.vecMul v R)

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.exists_rightCanonical_normalized
roots.source_signature:
theorem exists_rightCanonical_normalized {n l : ℕ} (C : Chain n l 1)
    (v : Fin l → ℝ) (hv : chainMass C v = 1) :
    ∃ (l' : ℕ) (R : _root_.Matrix (Fin l) (Fin l') ℝ) (D : Chain n l' 1),
      RightCanonical D ∧ RankReduced C D ∧
      (∀ x, contract C x = R * contract D x) ∧ mass (_root_.Matrix.vecMul v R) = 1

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.exists_normalized_state
roots.source_signature:
theorem exists_normalized_state {n : ℕ} (C : Chain n 1 1)
    (hC : (∑ x : Word n, (contract C x 0 0) ^ 2) = 1) :
    ∃ (l' : ℕ) (u : Fin l' → ℝ) (D : Chain n l' 1),
      RightCanonical D ∧ RankReduced C D ∧ mass u = 1 ∧
      ∀ x, contract C x 0 0 = ∑ a, u a * contract D x a 0

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore

    _root_.Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin r) (Fin l) ℂ

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore_isometry
roots.source_signature:
theorem complexCore_isometry {l r : ℕ} (A : Core l r)
    (hA : A * A.transpose = 1) :
    (complexCore A).conjTranspose * complexCore A = 1

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.sequentialCore
roots.source_signature: def sequentialCore {r : ℕ} (A : Core r r) : SequentialBondPreparation.Core (Fin r)

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.sequential_step
roots.source_signature:
theorem sequential_step {n r : ℕ} (A : Core r r)
    (U : SequentialBondPreparation.Stage (Fin r))
    (hU : ∀ bit b a, U (bit, b) (0, a) = complexCore A (bit, b) a)
    (v : SequentialBondPreparation.BondState n (Fin r))
    (x : PrimitiveBasis (n + 1)) (b : Fin r) :
    SequentialBondPreparation.step U v (x, b) =
      ∑ a, (A a (x (Fin.last n), b) : ℂ) * v (Fin.init x, a)

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.padVector
roots.source_signature: def padVector {d B : ℕ} (v : Fin d → ℂ) (b : Fin B) : ℂ

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.padVector_active
roots.source_signature:
@[simp] theorem padVector_active {d B : ℕ} (hd : d ≤ B) (v : Fin d → ℂ)
    (a : Fin d) : padVector v (Fin.castLE hd a) = v a

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.paddedCore
roots.source_signature: def paddedCore {l r B : ℕ} (A : Core l r) : SequentialBondPreparation.Core (Fin B)

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.paddedCore_inactive_output
roots.source_signature:
theorem paddedCore_inactive_output {l r B : ℕ} (A : Core l r)
    (bit : Fin 2) (b a : Fin B) (hb : r ≤ b.val) : paddedCore A (bit, b) a = 0

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.sum_padVector
roots.source_signature:
theorem sum_padVector {d B : ℕ} (hd : d ≤ B) (f : Fin B → ℂ) (v : Fin d → ℂ) :
    (∑ a : Fin B, f a * padVector v a) =
      ∑ a : Fin d, f (Fin.castLE hd a) * v a

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.sequential_step_padded
roots.source_signature:
theorem sequential_step_padded {n l r B : ℕ} (hl : l ≤ B) (A : Core l r)
    (U : SequentialBondPreparation.Stage (Fin B))
    (columns : ∀ bit b (a : Fin l),
      U (bit, b) (0, Fin.castLE hl a) = paddedCore A (bit, b) (Fin.castLE hl a))
    (v : PrimitiveBasis n × Fin l → ℂ) (x : PrimitiveBasis (n + 1)) (b : Fin B) :
    SequentialBondPreparation.step U
      (fun z => padVector (fun a => v (z.1, a)) z.2) (x, b) =
      padVector (fun c : Fin r =>
        ∑ a : Fin l, (A a (x (Fin.last n), c) : ℂ) * v (Fin.init x, a)) b

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.paddedCore_active_isometry
roots.source_signature:
theorem paddedCore_active_isometry {l r B : ℕ} (hl : l ≤ B) (hr : r ≤ B)
    (A : Core l r) (hA : A * A.transpose = 1) (a c : Fin l) :
    (∑ out : Fin 2 × Fin B,
      star (paddedCore A out (Fin.castLE hl a)) *
        paddedCore A out (Fin.castLE hl c)) = if a = c then 1 else 0

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainNormEnvironment.gram_scalar
roots.source_signature:
theorem gram_scalar {n : ℕ} (C : Chain n 1 1) :
    gram C 0 0 = ∑ x : Word n, (contract C x 0 0) ^ 2

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainNormEnvironment.gram_scalar_nonneg
roots.source_signature: theorem gram_scalar_nonneg {n : ℕ} (C : Chain n 1 1) : 0 ≤ gram C 0 0

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainNormEnvironment.norm

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainNormEnvironment.norm_eq
roots.source_signature:
theorem norm_eq {n : ℕ} (C : Chain n 1 1) :
    norm C = Real.sqrt (∑ x : Word n, (contract C x 0 0) ^ 2)

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainNormEnvironment.norm_sq
roots.source_signature:
theorem norm_sq {n : ℕ} (C : Chain n 1 1) :
    norm C ^ 2 = ∑ x : Word n, (contract C x 0 0) ^ 2

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainNormEnvironment.norm_pos_of_nonzero
roots.source_signature:
theorem norm_pos_of_nonzero {n : ℕ} (C : Chain n 1 1)
    (h : ∃ x, contract C x 0 0 ≠ 0) : 0 < norm C

roots.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainNormEnvironment.norm_eq_of_contract
roots.source_signature:
theorem norm_eq_of_contract {n : ℕ} {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (C : Chain n 1 1) (e : Word n ≃ I) (target : I → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x, contract C x 0 0 = target (e x)) :
    norm C = Real.sqrt (∑ i : I, target i ^ 2)
